title: MyLLC Manager 2.0: the client iPhone and iPad app is built and in private testing
text: The client portal now exists as a real app, MyLLC Manager 2.0, for iPhone and iPad. It has a native bottom bar and Menu, files, sign out, English and Italian, and it asks for permission to send alerts after sign-in. A build was sent to Apple's TestFlight for private testing on 10 November. It has not been submitted to Apple for review and is not in the App Store yet.
points: The server side for the app was switched on in production on 10 November. The website works the same as before.
Lock-screen alerts say only who wrote and what kind of thing it is, never the message, a file name or an amount, and go to the same people who get the browser alert.
The plan is a private test first, then a public launch in January 2027.
